title: Newsletter
description: An inline subscribe form in a bordered panel, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Field, Button and Alert primitives: a serif heading, one line of description, an email field beside a Subscribe button and a short note, with its own empty, disabled, loading, error and subscribed renders; responds to its container (@container) — the field and the button share one row at @sm, the heading steps up at @md and the text and the form split into two columns at @lg.
